issues: Broken list/numbering structure: in the original, the 'Mengingat' list contains a duplicated item number '2.' and also includes standalone page markers ('2 -', '3 -', '- 4 -'); the translation renumbered the duplicated '2.' to '3.' and omitted the page markers, so list markers do not match the source.

Meaning drift: item 14 cites 'State Gazette ... of 2005' in both original and translation, but the translation should preserve the original citation exactly; also the duplicated numbering must be preserved as in the source for downstream boundary matching.

Broken structure/leftover pagination artifacts: standalone lines "2 -", "3 -", and "- 4 -" are carried over from page numbering and are not part of the legal text; one is also embedded mid-sentence in item 18.
Meaning drift/grammar: "the Regional Government together with the community is obliged" should be plural ("are obliged") to match the subject and avoid ambiguity in legal obligation phrasing.
Broken list/numbering structure: in Article 1 item 14 is missing the required line break/termination and runs into item 15 (missing Markdown line break after item 14).

Leftover non-content text: stray page marker "7 -" appears in the translation (also present in the source as a page artifact) and should be removed from the translated legal text to avoid downstream parsing errors.
Original has a standalone page marker "7 -" between Article 3 and BAB III; it is missing from the translation (content omission affecting downstream boundary-sensitive processing).
Scrambled/merged list marker in Article 12: "dane." rendered as "ande."; must be separate item "e." and keep "dan" as "and" between items d and e.
Scrambled numbering in Article 13: paragraph (2) is merged into the page marker line "10 - (2)" instead of being a separate list item "2.".
Scrambled list marker in Article 18: item "e." is merged into item "d." line; must be a separate "e." item.
Typo in heading: "Paragarf 6" should be "Paragraph 6" to match the original heading ("Paragraf 6").

Broken/scrambled list structure: in Article 7(1) and Article 7(2), the list marker "a." is attached to the preceding clause ("obligated to:" / "authority to:") instead of appearing as a separate list item, and item "f." in Article 7(1) is run on after item "e."

Meaning drift/typo in cross-reference: Article 19 refers to "Article 12 letter f" but the original refers to Pasal 12 huruf f even though Pasal 12 only has a–e; this should follow the original reference (keep "letter f"), but the translation should not introduce inconsistency elsewhere (no change needed to the reference itself).

Scrambled list/numbering structure in Article 24(2): the list marker "a." is attached to the preceding sentence ("...realized by:a.") instead of being a separate list item, unlike the original which has "...dengan:" followed by "a." on its own item.
